text:
Hi there! How wonderful that you're sending a plant gift to your sister! 🌿

Great news on both fronts:

**The price:** No, she won't see what you paid. Gift orders ship with a special gift packing slip that doesn't include any pricing information.

**Your message:** Yes, absolutely! You can add a free printed gift note with your order. You can include up to **200 characters**, so you have plenty of room for a personal message.

When you're placing the order, just look for the gift options at checkout and add your note there. It'll be included in the package.

Is there anything else you'd like to know about getting the plant ready for your sister? 😊
